name: The New School of San Francisco
entry_grades: TK/K through 8 can apply. The school does not publish seats per grade.
how_admission_works: Own random lottery through SchoolMint, separate from SFUSD; families may enter both. Unplaced applicants go on a waitlist that is cleared at the end of that school year.
preferences: In order: (1) SF residents eligible for free or reduced-price meals, until they fill 50% of the grade, (2) siblings, (3) children of staff or board (max 10% of enrollment), (4) other SF residents, (5) non-residents.
deadline: 2027-28 cycle: application closes March 5, 2027; lottery March 12, 2027.
demand_numbers: More than 700 applications in roughly the 2019-20 cycle, with more than 100 waitlisted students qualifying for free or reduced lunch (co-founders' op-ed, February 2020). No newer figures found.
notes: Offers TK. Half of seats are reserved for low-income students.

name: Creative Arts Charter School
entry_grades: Kindergarten and 6th grade are the named entry points (from the 2025-26 application page); other grades through the waitlist. The site lists the school as TK-8.
how_admission_works: Own random public lottery (SchoolMint application), separate from SFUSD. Late applications join the waitlist in the order received. The waitlist does not roll over, so families reapply each year.
preferences: From the 2025-26 page, not confirmed for 2027-28: current students; siblings; SF public housing residents (10% of K, 20% of 6th grade spots); children of full-time staff; SF residents.
deadline: 2027-28 cycle: apply by February 1, 2027; lottery March 3, 2027; results public the week of March 15, 2027.
notes: The school asks families to attend a tour. Accepted families who live outside SF need an inter-district transfer.

name: Mission Preparatory School
how_admission_works: Families apply directly to the school through SchoolMint, not through SFUSD. The school's site does not describe the lottery itself.
demand_numbers: A waitlist of approximately 623 students, reported by the executive director at an SFUSD charter renewal hearing. The article is undated and appears to be from about 2020. No newer figure found.
notes: Serves TK-8. No 2026-27 or 2027-28 dates are published on the site, so contact the school.

name: Edison Charter Academy
entry_grades: TK and K mainly (for 2027-28, TK must turn 4 and K must turn 5 by September 1, 2027). Grades 1-8 can apply and are placed through waitlist rounds.
how_admission_works: Own electronic lottery through SchoolMint (or a paper form); it does not take part in the SFUSD lottery. After the first round, waitlist lotteries run in April, May, August, September, October and December.
preferences: Current students, siblings and children of staff first; then San Francisco residents; then non-residents.
deadline: 2027-28 cycle: online application October 23, 2026 to February 8, 2027; first lottery late February 2027; results by mid-March 2027.
notes: Also known as Thomas Edison Charter Academy. Spanish-English dual language in two of three K classrooms. Its 2027-2032 charter renewal goes to an SFUSD board decision on December 1, 2026.

name: KIPP Bayview Elementary
entry_grades: The school serves TK-4. The page does not say which grades have open seats.
how_admission_works: No admission requirements. If applications exceed seats, a random blind lottery is held. Applications after the deadline are taken first-come, first-served as space opens.
deadline: 2027-28 cycle: applications opened October 13, 2026; open enrollment deadline March 4, 2027; lottery March 11, 2027.

name: KIPP Bayview Academy
entry_grades: The school serves 5-8. The page does not name an entry grade.
how_admission_works: No admission requirements. If applications exceed seats, a random blind lottery is held. Applications after the deadline are taken first-come, first-served as space opens.
deadline: 2027-28 cycle: applications opened October 13, 2026; open enrollment deadline March 4, 2027; lottery March 11, 2027.

name: KIPP San Francisco Bay Academy
entry_grades: The school serves 5-8. The page does not name an entry grade.
how_admission_works: No admission requirements. If applications exceed seats, a random blind lottery is held. Applications after the deadline are taken first-come, first-served as space opens.
deadline: 2027-28 cycle: applications opened October 13, 2026; open enrollment deadline March 4, 2027; lottery March 11, 2027.

name: KIPP San Francisco College Preparatory
entry_grades: The school serves 9-12. The page does not name an entry grade.
how_admission_works: No admission requirements. If applications exceed seats, a random blind lottery is held. Applications after the deadline are taken first-come, first-served as space opens.
deadline: 2027-28 cycle: open enrollment deadline March 4, 2027; lottery March 11, 2027.

name: Gateway Middle School
entry_grades: 6th grade mainly; transfers into 7th and 8th as space permits.
how_admission_works: Own lottery, separate from SFUSD, with a separate Gateway application. Applicants not offered a seat, and late applicants, enter a wait pool with rolling lotteries all year as seats open.
preferences: Listed without a stated ranking: San Francisco residents, siblings of current students, children of staff and faculty, families qualifying for free and reduced lunch.
deadline: 2027-28 cycle: application opened October 2, 2026; round 1 deadline February 1, 2027; lottery results March 12, 2027; accept or decline by March 26, 2027.
demand_numbers: From the school's FAQ for the 2027-28 cycle: the 6th grade wait pool is around 200 students, and the 7th and 8th grade wait pools each have approximately 30. No application or seat counts are published.
notes: Students with learning differences go through the same lottery.

name: Gateway High School
entry_grades: 9th grade mainly; transfers into other grades as space permits.
how_admission_works: Own lottery, separate from SFUSD, with a separate Gateway application. Applicants not offered a seat, and late applicants, enter a wait pool with rolling lotteries all year as seats open.
preferences: Listed without a stated ranking: San Francisco residents, Gateway Middle School students, siblings of current students, children of staff and faculty, families qualifying for free and reduced lunch.
deadline: 2027-28 cycle: application opened October 2, 2026; round 1 deadline February 1, 2027; lottery results March 12, 2027; accept or decline by March 26, 2027.
notes: SFUSD staff recommended renewing the charter from July 2027 (report dated November 16, 2026); the report gave no applicant or waitlist counts.

name: City Arts & Leadership Academy
how_admission_works: Families apply directly to the school online through PowerSchool Enrollment, separate from SFUSD. The school's own pages give no lottery details; a third-party guide describes an open lottery with no test or fee.
deadline: No 2027-28 dates published by the school; its site only says applications are open. A third-party guide gives a late-February priority deadline and early-March lottery for the prior cycle.
notes: SFUSD's charter page says the school's 2027-31 renewal petition was withdrawn on October 27, 2026, and its current charter term reportedly ends June 30, 2027, so its future beyond 2026-27 is unclear.

name: Life Learning Academy Charter
entry_grades: Grades 9-12; students can start at any time of year.
how_admission_works: No lottery. A family member, service provider or the student calls the school, followed by a short phone call, a student-led tour and a one-on-one interview. Students can start as soon as the next day.
notes: Very small classes (6-8 students) and an on-campus housing program. Takes students from across the Bay Area, including those who have been out of school.
